messages:
Maria Chen: FYI — Sales closed FinDataX (APAC) on Redwood Dedicated. They want a committed throughput SLA and predictable latency for a 24/7 transformer workload. Need sizing recs and a quick cost sanity check.
Anjali Rao: what model + sequence length + expected qps/avg tokens per call?
Maria Chen: model: opt-6.7b int8 (our quant path). avg seq ~512, p50 latency ~120ms, p95 ~340ms observed in staging. avg tokens per request ~220. They said sustained 600k tokens/min with 500k token bursts up to 2h/day.
Kevin Patel: APAC capacity note — A100 inventory is patchy in the customer's preferred region. If we commit A100s there, margin vs on-demand is tight; V100/80GB isn't viable for this model without perf hit. Also watch inter-AZ egress and GPU host pricing (e.g. 20–30% uplift).
Samir Gupta: SLA ask is 99.9 for throughput. We should propose a multi-AZ commit slab with cross-zone failover and a small on-demand burst pool. Do they want dedicated GPUs per AZ or a pooled commit? Sales said single contract level.
Lindsey (billing): need a cost calc we can show customer. Quick template: ```
# monthly reserved cost ≈ reserved_gpu_count * hourly_rate * 24 * days_in_month
reserved_gpus=6
hourly_rate=3.75 # example
monthly_cost=$(reserved_gpus * hourly_rate * 24 * 30) # ~16200
```
Lindsey (billing): also need to add egress, storage, and network NAT costs; APAC egress can add ~10–15% on top of compute in some clouds.
Anjali Rao: perf data from our bench: one A100 (our kernel + batching) sustains ~80k tokens/min for that model at p50~120ms. That implies ~8 A100s for 600k sustained, plus ~2–3 GPUs headroom for bursts and failover. But batching assumptions change with qps shape.
Kevin Patel: +1. Also account for cold-start queueing and KV cache warmup. For prefix-heavy workloads we get 8–12% effective token reduction with prefix cache; if they can cache frequently, we can shrink commit by ~1 GPU.
Maria Chen: Sales wants a simple proposal: "commit sized to SLA with optional burst pool". Can we put three phasing options: conservative, staged ramp, and aggressive reserve?
Samir Gupta: Proposed tiers:
- Staged Ramp: commit 3 A100 now (start), 30-day telemetry, scale to 6 if sustained. Provide 2 on-demand GPUs for bursts.
- Conservative Commit: reserve 8 A100 (multi-AZ split 5/3), 10% headroom, on-demand burst optional.
- Aggressive Commit: 10 A100 reserved + 2 on-demand for 99.99-style headroom.
Anjali Rao: technical caveats: our throughput test is with continuous streams and ideal batching. Real customer qps (many small calls) will reduce tokens/min per GPU. We should ask FinDataX for a 48h sample trace or at least request rate histogram (p50/p90/p99 latencies and request size distribution).
Maria Chen: +1 — I'll ask Sales to get a 48h trace or export of their prod request logs (anonymized). @Kevin, can you estimate a correction factor for small-request heavy tails?
Kevin Patel: quick rule of thumb: if >40% of requests are <64 tokens, effective throughput per GPU drops ~25–35%. If they have long-tail spikes, plan for extra burst capacity. Also network egress spikes when models return long completions.
Lindsey (billing): once we have target GPU counts, I can run a pricing comparison across regions and present monthly commit vs on-demand delta and break-even months.
ops-bot: Deploybot: new benchmark cluster created for opt-6.7b-int8 in ap-northeast-1 (id: bench-2123). Logs: https://bench.internal/run/2123
Anjali Rao: Recommendation from infra:
- Ask for 48h trace
- Start with staged ramp (3 reserved, 2 on-demand), telemetry gates at 7/30 days
- Include prefix caching config and request-level caching as part of onboarding
- If they require immediate 600k sustained, propose 8 reserved A100 across two AZs with a 2-GPU burst pool and a 5–7% committed discount.
Maria Chen: ok. Action items:
- Sales: get 48h anonymized trace + SLA clarification (sales@) — assigned: Maria
- Infra (perf): run corrected perf sweep for small request mixes and attach numbers — assigned: Anjali, Kevin — due EOD+2
- Billing: prepare cost delta spreadsheet for 3/6/8 GPU commits including egress uplift and storage — assigned: Lindsey — due EOD+3
- Product ops: draft onboarding playbook with caching + warmup checklist — assigned: Samir — due EOD+5
Samir Gupta: I'll also draft fallback policy (route to hosted variants if regional pool exhausted) — will sync with product ops.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone. I'll update Sales with staged proposal and link this thread. :thumbsup:
